examples.description: Apply every document op once, in one atomic batch against version 3

description: Apply several edits atomically against base_version; any refusal applies nothing and names the failing op. Small models: prefer the single-purpose verbs. Each op is {op, args}; the ops and their args are: add_scene_from_asset {asset_id, at_index?}; delete_elements {element_ids, ripple_secondary?}; shift_clips {clip_ids, delta_ms}; duplicate_clips {clip_ids, at_ms}; insert_time {at_ms, length_ms}; ripple_delete {element_id, scope?}; roll_edit {left_id, right_id, delta_ms}; slip_edit {clip_id, delta_ms}; slide_edit {clip_id, delta_ms}; move_caption {caption_id?, at_ms?, delta_ms}; cut_transcript_span {from_caption_id, to_caption_id, from_word_index?, to_word_index?}; add_track {role, name?}; remove_track {track_id, delete_clips?}; move_track {track_id, position}; rename_track {track_id, name}; set_track_muted {track_id, muted}; move_clips_to_track {clip_ids, track_id, delta_ms?}; place_product_card {stock_item_id, product_name, sell_price_cents, currency, start_ms?, duration_ms?, style?, track_id?}. base_version is the composition_version you last read; a stale one is refused with a 409 that carries head_version, so re-read with studio.get_composition and resend. Send 1 to 50 ops per call.

base_version.description: The composition_version your ops were planned against (0 for a project with no saved composition).

ops.description: The edits, applied in order; all land or none do.

args.description: The op's own arguments; the tool description lists which ones each op takes.

asset_id.description: A video or image asset id (vas_...) from get_composition's assets list.

at_index.description: 0-based position in scene order; appends when omitted.

at_ms.description: Timeline millisecond where the earliest copy starts.

caption_id.description: The caption row (vc_) to move. Leave it out and pass at_ms instead to pick the row showing then.

clip_id.description: A video or audio clip (vcl_) or a scene (vs_) with finished video.

clip_ids.description: Timeline clip ids (vcl_) from get_composition's tracks; duplicates count once.

currency.description: The ISO code the price prints with; the business's sales_settings default_currency.

delete_clips.description: true removes the track's clips with it; left out, a track with clips is refused.

delta_ms.description: Milliseconds to move every listed clip; negative moves them earlier.

duration_ms.description: How long the card shows, in milliseconds; 4000 when left out.

element_id.description: A scene (vs_) or timeline clip (vcl_) id from get_composition.

element_ids.description: Scene (vs_), clip (vcl_), sticker (vov_) or caption (vc_) ids; duplicates count once.

from_caption_id.description: The caption row (vc_) the span starts in.

from_word_index.description: 0-based index of the first word to cut in the from row; the row's start when left out.

left_id.description: The scene or clip before the cut.

length_ms.description: How much time to insert, 100 to 600000ms (one placeholder scene).

muted.description: true silences the track; false plays it again.

name.description: A display name up to 40 characters; the role's label shows when left out.

position.description: 0-based position among the tracks of the same role; 0 draws lowest.

product_name.description: The item's name as the stock record holds it.

right_id.description: The scene or clip right after the cut.

ripple_secondary.description: For deleted scenes: "shift" (default) removes their time from every lane; "none" closes the main track alone. Clips, stickers and captions ignore it.

role.description: The kind of track: video-broll, text, audio-music or audio-voice.

scope.description: "all_tracks" (default) closes the time on every lane; "own_track" closes it on the element's own lane only.

sell_price_cents.description: The selling price in cents (1290 prints as 12.90).

start_ms.description: Timeline millisecond where the card appears; 0 when left out.

stock_item_id.description: The stock item's id from stock_item_list; kept on the card so it can be refreshed from the record.

style.description: The card's layout; tag when left out.

to_caption_id.description: The caption row (vc_) the span ends in; the same id as from_caption_id for a span inside one row.

to_word_index.description: 0-based index of the last word to cut in the to row; the row's end when left out.

project_id.description: The studio project (vp_…) this batch edits.

name: studio.apply_ops
